Mara: FYI saw an odd billing diff on the canary this morning. Suspect inter-region fallback + retry produced duplicate confirmed credits.
Devon: ugh, any trace ids?
Mara: yes, trace=tr-2026-03-23-01. Quick sanitized excerpt below.
Mara: ```
2026-03-23T01:04:12Z trace=tr-2026-03-23-01 route=eu-central-1 req=xq-11 client_session=cs-700 toolcall_id=tc-900 truncated_after=980 provisional=1000
2026-03-23T01:04:15Z client retried -> routed to ap-southeast-1 route=ap-southeast-1 req=xq-11 client_session=cs-700 toolcall_id= (none) provisional=1000
2026-03-23T01:04:21Z ledger: both provisional -> confirmed; charged 2000 tokens
```
Priya: Not surprising. Our dedupe key is toolcall_id; absent toolcall_id means no dedupe across routes.
Lee: That nails it. Truncation leaves first flow provisional until ack; retry without idempotency token spins up second provisional. If both confirm we double-charge.
Mara: Is this strictly a toolcall problem? Or could normal streaming users hit it?
Devon: streaming too, but toolcalls higher risk due to bigger responses and retries triggered by timeouts.
Priya: Short-term: we should add an ops reconciliation that looks for identical client_session+prompt_hash+time-window duplicates across regions and mark suspects. Mid-term: add a propagated flow identifier that survives routing.
Lee: Propose header X-RW-Flow-Id (or X-Redwood-Flow) that gateway attaches on initial ingress and copies on any reroute. Downstream services use flow-id as dedupe key when present.
Mara: That requires gateway + router changes and a migration plan. We need backward compatibility.
Devon: Agree. Also want improved telemetry: each provisional allocation should emit provisional_origin={route, host, flow_id?} and ledger confirmation should emit confirmed_origin. Then console can show "provisional path -> confirmed path" mismatches.
Priya: Console idea: a small panel on per-tenant billing showing "provisional leakage" (sum of provisional that later confirmed on different route) with a filter for last 48h. That makes regressions visible to SRE/product.
Lee: Could we also implement a ledger-side heuristic dedupe: if flow-id missing, dedupe on (client_session, model, prompt_hash, short_ttl) within N seconds. Defensive only; still require flow-id for full correctness.
Mara: Risk: heuristics may underbill if they dedupe distinct retries. We should flag any heuristic hit for manual review rather than auto-refund.
Devon: Agreed. Heuristic should only mark suspect duplicates; reconcile job decides refunds.
Priya: Immediate actions I suggest: 1) add Grafana alert for route-level spike where confirmed_tokens > provisional_tokens * 1.8 (indicative of double confirmations), 2) reconciliation job that queries traces for confirmed-but-duplicated client_session+req and surfaces to billing-ops, 3) small canary change to copy flow-id when present.
Lee: I'll own the gateway change to propagate X-RW-Flow-Id and update router gossip logic. Will add a feature flag for the canary.
Mara: Priya can you add the provisional_origin telemetry tags?
Priya: Yep, will open PR for trace + metrics tags and a console toggle to surface the leakage panel.
Devon: I'll draft the reconciliation query and the alert runbook. Also add a metric "percent_confirmed_from_different_route" to the canary dashboard.
Mara: opsbot, please open ticket for billing-ops and tag finance.
opsbot: created ticket BLG-2026-77 (billing-ops) and pinged @billing-team.
Lee: Tests: unit + e2e harness that simulates truncation -> retry across routes with and without flow-id. Add ledger unit tests to ensure flow-id dedupe wins.
Devon: One more ask: add a small telemetry counter for requests missing both toolcall_id and flow_id so we can track clients that don't send idempotency info.
Priya: good call. I'll add metric "missing_idempotency_header_pct" on tenant dashboards.
Mara: Owners: Lee -> gateway + router; Priya -> telemetry + console; Devon -> alert/runbook + reconcile; Mara -> billing-ops liaison.
Lee: timeline: canary on Monday for header propagation (feature-flagged).
Priya: console PR this week.
Devon: runbook + reconcile draft by EOD tomorrow.
Mara: thanks team. We'll follow up in this thread with PR links. If anyone sees more anomalous spikes please drop traces here. :eyes:
Devon: noted. Adding the dashboard widgets now.
Priya: pinging @Lee for review on telemetry PR when ready.
opsbot: linked BLG-2026-77 to this thread.
